$comment: TEMPLATE - YA2027 is NOT law. Built from the Budget 2027 speech annex and MOF English tax measures (tabled 9 Oct 2026). No Finance Bill on Parliament's list as of 2026-11-05; no LHDN 2027 spec or TP1. Items not mentioned in Budget 2027 are carried forward from YA2026 and are unconfirmed.
bracketsNote: Rates/bands from Lampiran 1. taxAtLowerBound values computed by us from those rates (not published by MOF/LHDN).

individual.legalRef: ITA s.6A(2)(a); requires the s.46(1)(a) deduction
individual.mtd: built into B (Category 1 & 3: B reduced by 400)

spouse.condition: chargeable income <= 35,000 AND a deduction allowed under s.47(1) or (2) (includes alimony), or under s.45A for a wife
spouse.mtd: built into B for Category 2 only (B reduced by 800 in total). A rebate earned through alimony is not in B, so it shows only in annual tax.

zakatFitrah.cap: see totalCap: pooled with the other rebates under s.6A(4), not capped on its own. Excess is lost.
zakatFitrah.mtd: Current-month zakat is subtracted from MTD. Without additional remuneration, net = max(0, MTD - zakat). In a bonus month, net is not floored: payable = max(0, (MTD - zakat) + MTD_additional). The full zakat of each month is added to Z. Zakat paid outside payroll is declared on TP1 D1(a) and treated as current-month zakat.

departureLevyUmrah.amountRm: departure levy actually paid for own travel
departureLevyUmrah.cap: not more than 2 times; not hajj; own travel by air; pooled under totalCap
departureLevyUmrah.legalRef: ITA s.6A(2A) (amount), s.6A(2B)(a) (2-time limit), s.6A(2B)(b) (hajj exclusion)
departureLevyUmrah.mtd: TP1 D1(b): treated like current-month zakat and carried into Z (spec section E note 5)

rebates.$comment: Budget 2027 does not mention rebates; carried forward (unconfirmed).

totalCap.formula: rebatesUsed = min(taxCharged, self + spouse + levy + zakat); taxPayable = taxCharged - rebatesUsed
totalCap.excess: lost: not refunded, not set against this or a later year's tax
totalCap.ordering: none: one pooled cap, so the order of the rebates does not change tax payable

rebateCliff.note: Payable tax jump just above RM35,000 chargeable income. Category 2 jumps by about RM600, not RM800, because rebate above the RM600 tax charged was already lost under s.6A(4).

nonResident.mtd: MTD = 30% x (remuneration + BIK + VOLA + additional remuneration), exempt allowances excluded, then the general rules: truncate to 2 dp, MTD < RM10 -> 0 (before rounding), round up to next 5 sen. No reliefs, rebates or categories.
nonResident.$comment: Not mentioned in Budget 2027; carried forward (unconfirmed).
nonResident.shortStayExemption: Sch.6 para 21 (subject to para 22): employment income of a non-resident for periods of 60 days or less is exempt.
nonResident.zakat: No zakat or levy rebate and no MTD offset: s.6A(1) rebates tax only for a resident individual, and the spec puts zakat terms only in the resident formulas. Take-home falls by the full zakat. A foreign employee on a contract of 182 days or more runs the resident MTD path, so netting happens during the year.

reliefs.label: Individual and dependent relatives
Disabled individual (additional)
reliefs.note: Must be registered with JKM. Was 6,000 up to YA2024.

reliefs.label: Husband / wife (no income or joint assessment) or alimony to former wife
reliefs.note: Not allowed if the spouse is assessed separately (s.47(4)), or if a non-disabled spouse has foreign-source gross income above RM4,000 (s.45A(2), s.47(5)). Spouse relief + alimony share the 4,000 cap (s.47(3)).

reliefs.label: Disabled husband / wife (additional)
reliefs.note: Was 5,000 up to YA2024. Not free-standing: available only where the spouse deduction conditions are met, so Su = 0 in Category 3 (spouse assessed separately) and for single, divorced or widowed employees. Sits outside the s.47(3) cap.

reliefs.label: Child relief

age18PlusPreTertiary.note: A-Level, certificate, matriculation or preparatory courses

age18PlusDiplomaOrDegree.note: diploma+ in Malaysia, degree+ outside Malaysia, or serving under articles or indentures to qualify in a trade or profession (s.48(3)(a)); approved institution

disabledAge18PlusStudyingDiplomaOrDegree.note: includes a disabled child serving under articles or indentures

reliefs.note: Category 1 forces C = 0. Where two or more people are each entitled to claim the same child (for example divorced parents), each gets 50% under s.48(4), so C can be fractional: 0.5, 2 or 4 units instead of 1, 4 or 8. A husband and wife living together choose: a wife assessed separately may elect the whole deduction (s.48(1) proviso; PR 7/2025 Example 49 still gives her 50% if a third person is entitled). No relief for a child whose own total income exceeds the deduction (s.48(5)). Under-18 is tested at any time in the basis year. Spouses may each claim different children. The MTD spec has no half-unit rule, so fractional C is confirmed by the Act and the calculator for an under-18 child only.

reliefs.label: EPF / approved scheme (mandatory or voluntary EPF)

mtd.variable: K, K1, K2, Kt (voluntary EPF on TP1 C11a -> LP1)

section49Rule.formula: s49b = min(4000, compulsory + voluntaryEpf); voluntaryLeft = voluntaryEpf - max(0, s49b - compulsory); s49a = min(3000, lifeInsurance + voluntaryLeft); total = min(7000, s49b + s49a)
section49Rule.note: The 7,000 needs voluntary EPF of at least 4,000 when there is no mandatory EPF. Life insurance alone never exceeds 3,000. Checks (e-BE YA2025 notes G17): Saiful 3,000; Sally 7,000; Charlene 7,000; Manaf 7,000.

reliefs.label: Life insurance / family takaful premiums or additional voluntary EPF
reliefs.note: Self, spouse and children (from YA2026; child criteria: <18 unmarried, 18+ unmarried in tertiary education, or unmarried disabled any age). 49(1)(a)+(b) combined cap 7,000.

Education or medical insurance premiums (self, spouse, child)
SOCSO (Act 4) + EIS (Act 800) employee contributions

giftDeductions.$comment: Moved out of reliefs: a gift deduction applies between aggregate income and total income, before reliefs. Same for YA2025, YA2026 and the YA2027 template.
uncapped: s.44(6) money to Government, State Government or local authority
s.44(6A) artefacts, manuscripts, paintings to Government (value as determined)
s.44(11) paintings to art galleries (value as determined)
giftDeductions.baseNote: Base is aggregate income (BE item B6), before reliefs and not reduced by EPF. A gift lowers chargeable income, so it can bring someone under the RM35,000 rebate limit.
giftDeductions.mtd: annualOnly: not on TP1 and not in the MTD spec. Only counts if a return is filed.
giftDeductions.carryForward: none found (reading of the provisions, not an express statement)
giftDeductions.status: carried forward (unconfirmed). Budget 2027 Lampiran 10 widens the scope of school funds under s.44(6) and restates 10%.

terminationPayments.$comment: Exempt share of termination and retirement payments. Only the taxable excess enters Yt. Kt = 0 on these items.
